claims.statement: No public or indirect production input selects a safety-authoritative storage location.
Every legacy production writer is removed or fails closed before safety-state mutation.
One immutable package identity yields exactly one exclusive registry key across reinstallations.
Every production reservation, live start, terminal claim, and terminal bank boundary is source-derived and composition-tested.
Concurrent or restarted contenders admit one package attempt and one terminal decision, with every loser aborting before package start.
Qualification and production authorities, reservations, claims, and sinks cannot cross modes.
Live safety state uses exclusive create, exact write, file fsync, parent-directory fsync, and readback.
Strict-abort, virtual composition, and independent default-deny sandbox evidence establish zero live-registry writes and no checkpoint access.
Numerical V4, result V11, collapsed-GO, checkpoint identity V12, and freezing-policy bytes do not drift.
